text:
anya: spotted a small a11y regression in the alerts flyout — tabbing wraps to the top header instead of landing on the first alert item after closing a nested menu.
todd: repro'd it. Flow: open Alerts -> open kebab menu on an alert -> close menu -> Tab goes to top header (unexpected). feels like focus trap leak.
rhea: likely because the menu close uses removeChild and focus is not restored to the originating button. we should set focus back to the toggler on close. also the focus outline is very faint at 2x zoom.
aria-bot: a11y-scan(alerts-flyout): failures: 2 (focus restoration, low focus contrast). report: https://ci.internal/a11y/2420000000
anya: minimal fix: store document.activeElement before opening menu, on close call savedElement.focus(). guard for timing if animation runs.
todd: sample patch:
```
const opener = document.activeElement;
openMenu();
menu.addEventListener('close', () => opener?.focus());
```
rhea: also add :focus-visible style:
```
.alert-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0B3B82; outline-offset: 3px; }
```
anya: acceptance criteria: 1) focus returns to menu toggler after close 2) Tab traversal stays within flyout while open 3) focus ring meets visibility at 2x zoom 4) unit test covers focus restoration.
aria-bot: created INS-9987, linked scan, ETA 3d, assignee @todd.
todd: will raise PR with the focus restore + CSS. will add an e2e that simulates keyboard open/close and checks activeElement.
rhea: small nit on copy: change menu item "Dismiss all" to "Dismiss all alerts" for clearer screen reader announcement.
anya: yep, clearer. please include the copy tweak in the PR.
todd: done. pushing branch now, will ping when CI passes.
aria-bot: INS-9987 branch pushed, a11y-e2e queued.
anya: thanks all, closing thread. :sparkles:
